Question
========
Explain the following concept, spelling out the acronym first if there is one. Give its definition and its usage, and if it has several usages, its most important one.

**RDMA**

Solution
========
Remote Direct Memory Access. The network card writes directly into the memory of a remote machine, without involving the remote CPU. Its most important use is very low latency and low CPU overhead communication inside a datacenter.
